review.how_it_works_title: How the app decides which word to show
review.how_it_works_correct: ✓ Answered correctly - the word rests. First a day, then 6 days, then the pause grows about 2.5× - up to a month.
review.how_it_works_wrong: ✗ Answered incorrectly - everything resets, and the word will show up almost every day again.
review.how_it_works_slow: ⏱ Answered slowly (close to 10 seconds) - the word will appear a bit more often than one you answered instantly. But this matters less than mistakes.
review.how_it_works_hint: 💡 Opened a hint - the answer counts, but the word will rest half as long as if you recalled it yourself. A hint means "almost knew it", not "knew it".
review.how_it_works_summary: The worse you remember a word - the more often it appears. The better - the rarer.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overview_text: Lex is a local-first application. All your data (words, translations, notes, examples, review statistics, and settings) is stored locally on your device in IndexedDB. The app does not require registration or an account.
privacy.local_storage_text: The following data is stored locally on your device via IndexedDB (Dexie.js): words and their translations, notes (associations, hints), example sentences, spaced repetition statistics (correct/incorrect counts, reaction times), and app settings (languages, theme, TTS). This data is not sent to a server and never leaves your device.
privacy.data_transmitted_intro: For translation, text-to-speech, dictionary entries, and feedback, the app sends data through a proxy server. Here is exactly what is transmitted:
privacy.data_translate_desc: word text, source and target language — sent to Yandex Translate API to get the translation.
privacy.data_dictionary_desc: word text, language pair — sent to Yandex Dictionary API to get dictionary entries and examples.
privacy.data_tts_desc: text and language — sent to Yandex SpeechKit for speech synthesis.
privacy.data_feedback_desc: category, message text, and contact (if provided) — sent via Telegram Bot API to the developer.
privacy.ip_address_text: The IP address is used by the proxy server only for rate limiting and is not stored permanently.
privacy.device_id_text: The app generates a random identifier (UUID) and stores it locally on your device. It is sent to the proxy server with each request so that daily translation and text-to-speech limits are tied to your device rather than to a shared IP address (important when many users share one IP). The identifier is not linked to your identity, contains no personal data, and is removed together with site data when you clear browser storage.
privacy.proxy_cache_text: Translations and audio (TTS) are cached in the proxy server's RAM (in-memory) with a limited time-to-live (TTL). The cache is not persisted to disk and is cleared on server restart.
privacy.third_parties_text: The app uses the following third-party services: Yandex (Translate API, SpeechKit for TTS, Dictionary API) and Telegram (Bot API for feedback). Transmitted data is processed in accordance with the privacy policies of these services.
privacy.analytics_text: The app does not use analytics, tracking, or automatic crash reports. No usage data is collected.
privacy.advertising_text: There is no advertising in the app.
privacy.data_deletion_text: You can delete all data at any time via Settings → Danger Zone → Reset everything. This will completely remove all words, statistics, and settings from your device.
privacy.age_text: The app is intended for users aged 13 and older.
privacy.contact_text: For privacy questions, contact donoriono@gmail.com or send a message via the feedback form in the app.

terms.user_responsibility_text: The user is responsible for the content they add to the dictionary (words, notes, examples). The app does not moderate user content, as it is stored locally on the device.
